notes.title: Minor Update - Alpha 2.1.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey Detectives, boy do we got an update for you![/b][/h3]

As always we’re so grateful for all the support from our playerbase, and we’re excited to share with you our final update for the Crime or Punishment demo!

Amongst the improvements we’ve made, we have new voice acting, new music, UI improvements, a Gun Safe, and so much more. Now the demo is “finished”, we’ll be moving on to development of the full game. We’ll talk more soon about why we’re stopping updates to the demo (for now) and share some sneak peeks of new content coming to Crime or Punishment! 

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] The office has a new Gun Safe that can be unlocked to access the extra revolvers that can be brought to the Speakeasy
[*] Agent Cooper has a new theme that plays during the conversation with Faulkner
[*] Movement and sprint controls are now prompted to the player in the Office
[*] The interact prompt icons change to reflect the optimal interact key, based on whether the player is using wasd or arrow keys
[*] Main menu overhaul
[*] New outline art that shows when a player takes a piece of evidence
[*] New dialogue box art 
[*] The sheet music evidence in the Speakeasy now has a red herring option
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Voice-over recordings have been revised to prioritise cleaner, more understandable audio
[*] The player will now be prompted and stopped if they try to leave the Office without the suspect dossiers folder. This prompt is specifically for the demo
[*] The first Office cutscene now triggers after the player has poured their morning drink and left the evidence window
[*] The player must check the police report delivered to their Desk by the Cop before receiving the call from the Mob Boss
[*] The Objective note the player receives on their desk, after the first Mob Boss call, has been rewritten to be clearer in its explanation of the player's objective within the Speakeasy
[*] Documents and items on the desk are now highlighted when hovered by the mouse
[*] Pressing escape in the Desk now closes the desk document, when one is pulled up, rather than exiting the Desk
[*] Various tweaks to dialogue and description text
[/list]
As always, thank you for your support; we can’t wait to show you what dark corners Detective Faulkner will be investigating next!

Scale Issue

notes.title: Hotfix - Alpha 2.0.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Detectives![/b][/h3]
Thank you for your enthusiasm and feedback on the demo! We've prepared a hotfix to address some bugs that we found during playtest, and add a little bit of new content.

Now that most bugs are fixed, we will focus on pacing and QoL updates. We're planning to expand the office as a tutorial area, and space out the text across the level. Let us know in the discord if you have any more feedback or suggestions! 

Discord link: https://discord.gg/P4kd8P9Fzt


[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] The photo frame on the Desk can now be interacted with
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The document buttons in the files window now show visual feedback when hovered by the mouse
[*] When in the Desk, other documents can no longer be selected from underneath a document that is currently being displayed
[*] Suspect folder has been removed from the Office after returning from the Speakeasy
[*] When moving between rooms in the Speakeasy, the detective will now be placed more accurately in front of entrance doors
[*] Dialogue can now be progress by clicking anywhere on the screen, or by pressing e, or enter
[*] Subtle shading has been added to the Desk
[*] Not yet implemented languages have been temporarily removed from the Languages dropdown in the options
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Agent Cooper now opens the office door instead of phasing through it
[*] The suspect folder’s sprite now disappears when the player picks it up in the Office
[*] The Glass Tumbler overworld sprite in the Speakeasy now changes back to filled when the player pours in a new drink
[*] When pouring new drinks into the Glass Tumbler, the pouring sound now plays for all options
[*] The escape button can now be used to leave the Closet window in the Speakeasy
[*] A mislabeled option for swapping a revolver in the Speakeasy has been amended
[*] The resolutions dropdown in the options menu now displays the correct selection of resolution options
[*] The Revolvers interactable in the Office is no longer missing an image
[*] The controls prompt at the start of the game now registers arrow keys
[*] Pressing escape to leave the Desk when a document is open, no longer causes that document to be stuck when re-entering the Desk
[*] The Sheet Music overworld sprite no longer renders over the detective
[*] Certain audio sources now accurately set their volume levels according to the volume slider in the options
[*] Resolution drop down in options now accurately displays supported resolutions
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] New executable icon
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and see you soon with update 2.1!

Scale Issue
